subject: general
question: Which of the following currency note was discarded by the Government of India in November 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 500**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Government of India announced the demonetization of the **Rs. 500** and **Rs. 1,000** currency notes on **8th November 2016**.
 
• This move was aimed at curbing black money, counterfeit currency, and corruption.
 
• New Rs. 500 and Rs. 2,000 notes were introduced after the demonetization.
